background.value: Light grey (Schengen standard; plain, uniform, no shadows or patterns)

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and visible

glasses_policy.value: Allowed only if eyes fully visible, no reflections, no tinted lenses

headwear_policy.value: Not allowed; exception for religious headwear only if face fully visible from chin to forehead

face_visibility.value: Full face visible, frontal view, eyes looking at camera

size.evidence: Switzerland follows the standard Schengen visa photo size of 35 x 45 mm. This is confirmed by the EU Visa Code Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 which mandates this size for all 27 Schengen member states. One official EDA document (from the South Africa consulate) mentions a range of '35-40 mm in width' suggesting some tolerance, but the standard specification remains 35 x 45 mm. The claimed source URL (eda.admin.ch) returned 403 Forbidden so the exact source page content could not be verified, but the dimension is correct per Schengen standards.
